title: High-Performance Computing
description: Designing and evaluating parallel algorithms for efficient execution, with an emphasis on scalability and computational performance.

title: Parallel and Distributed Computing
description: Developing parallel and distributed algorithms that balance workloads, reduce communication overhead, and coordinate execution efficiently.

title: GPU Computing and Parallel Graph Algorithms
description: Investigating GPU-accelerated maximum-flow algorithms, memory-efficient graph representations, and parallel processing with CUDA.

title: Heterogeneous Computing Systems
description: Studying workload partitioning and coordinated execution across CPU–GPU and ARM–GPU systems.

title: Resource Management and Workload Scheduling
description: Investigating communication-aware scheduling and load balancing to improve resource use and execution efficiency on heterogeneous systems.

title: High-Performance Nanopore Basecalling
description: Characterizing and optimizing nanopore basecalling workflows through parallel processing and workload scheduling across heterogeneous systems.

title: Energy-Efficient Computing
description: Evaluating the relationship between execution time, power consumption, and energy use in GPU algorithms and heterogeneous systems.

title: Algorithm Engineering and Performance Analysis
description: Connecting algorithm design with practical implementation through profiling, experimental evaluation, and architecture-aware optimization.
